Power-Ups Guide

Every pickup, unlock collectible, Banana Market boost, and live-event modifier—using the same values as the game.

Run Pickups Food Unlocks Market Boosts Live Events Skin Mastery XP Rewards

Run Pickups

Spawn rolls begin at score 25
🎲

Percentages are the chance rolled for each newly generated pipe. Several different pickups can appear together. A live Power-Up Party event doubles every listed spawn roll.

❤️

Extra Life

Restores 1 missing heart, up to your current run’s maximum. It cannot add a heart when you are already full.

Normal 5.1% Frenzy 35% Wonks 4% No Hardcore
🍌

Banana Coins

Gives 5 Banana Coins and 10 Monkey XP. An active Banana Doubler makes the pickup worth 10 coins.

Most modes 2.5% Wonks 5.5% Hardcore 1.5%
👻

Ghost

For about 12.5 seconds, you can pass through pipes without taking damage. Collecting 25 outside Frenzy/Hardcore unlocks Ghost Monkey.

Normal 0.4% Frenzy 15% Wonks 1.2% No Hardcore
🔥

Fire Power

About 12.5 seconds of safe pipe phasing, a red fire trail, 40% faster pipes, 35% stronger gravity, and +1 extra score per pipe.

Frenzy 8% Wonks 11% Frenzy/Wonks only
⚡

Glitch

About 12.5 seconds of pixel glitches, 40% faster pipes, and +1 extra score per pipe. Glitch does not make you invincible. Fire and Glitch together give +2 extra score and multiply pipe speed again.

Normal 0.4% Frenzy 12% No Wonks/Hardcore

Food Unlock Collectibles

Rare skin progress—not temporary powers
🍔

Each locked food skin has its own 0.6% roll per pipe in every mode after score 25. Every pickup gives 5 XP. Collect 10 of one food to unlock its matching Monkey skin and title; that food then stops spawning for you.

Banana Market Boosts

Activate from Market or Inventory
🎟️

Tickets stack in your Inventory. Arming one does not consume it—the count decreases only when a compatible run starts. You can deactivate it first to save it for later.

Extra Life Ticket · 150 🍌

Starts the next non-Hardcore run with 4 hearts instead of 3. The 8× Health event takes priority and starts you with 8.

Banana Doubler · 120 🍌

Doubles every Banana Coin pickup for one full run. It also works in Hardcore.

Score Booster · 200 🍌

Makes each passed pipe worth 4 base score for one non-Hardcore run. Bonus score never multiplies Skin Mastery XP.

2× Monkey XP · 180 🍌

Doubles all Monkey XP for 10 real-time minutes. During XP Frenzy, both multipliers combine for 4× XP.

Crate Luck Boost · 240 🍌

Improves reward rolls for the next 3 crates you open, then automatically expires.

Revive Token · 300 🍌

Once per non-Hardcore run, revives you at full hearts and gives a protected 3-2-1 restart countdown.

Live Event Modifiers

Several events can now run together
🍌 Banana Storm
All Banana Coin rewards are multiplied by 3.
⚡ XP Frenzy
All Monkey XP is doubled; stacks with the 2× XP Token for 4×.
🚀 Score Rush
All run score is doubled. Scores earned during this event are intentionally unranked.
🎉 Power-Up Party
Doubles every run-pickup and food-collectible spawn roll, capped at 100%.
❤️ 8× Health
Non-Hardcore runs begin with 8 maximum hearts.
📦 Crate Events
Crate Carnival and themed crate events improve the matching crate reward odds while active.

Monkey Skin Mastery

Five levels and five stars per skin
⭐

Play with a skin equipped to level that specific skin. Every score point you earn gives it 5 Skin XP. Skin XP is separate from your account-level Monkey XP, so buying Monkey XP in the Banana Market does not increase Skin Mastery.

Levels and stars
Each skin has Levels 1–5. Reaching each increasingly difficult level earns another star; Level 5 awards all five stars and marks that skin as Mastered.
Skin XP milestones
Level 2 at 250 Skin XP, Level 3 at 750, Level 4 at 1,750, and Level 5 at 3,500.
Where progress appears
Your current level, stars, Skin XP, progress bar, and XP to the next level appear on skin cards in the skin picker, Inventory, and the equipped lobby card.
Mastery rewards
Mastering skins is a fun challenge and does not make a skin stronger. Master 1, 3, 6, 9, and 25 skins to unlock the five exclusive mastery Auras.

XP & Unlock Rewards

Account progress saves when signed in
Pass a pipe
+1 XP, plus +50 XP when your score first crosses each new multiple of 50.
Collect a Banana
+10 XP and the Banana Coin reward.
550-point mode victory
+2,500 XP in Normal, Hardcore, Mini-Monkey, Chunky-Monkey, Power-Up Frenzy, Wonks Awakening, or Glitch Out.
Complete an achievement
+50 XP and the achievement is recorded in your Profile.
